core_obligations: Closed immersion and directedness: if Z is a subset of X_V locally closed and finite over V then Z -> X_V is a closed immersion since f is separated; finite scheme theoretic unions of closed subschemes finite over V remain closed and finite over V, so the colimit defining f_{p!}F(V) is directed (proof lines 1132-1137).
Directed colimit made explicit: in this case f_{p!}F(V) equals the set of sections of F(X_V) whose support is finite over V (proof lines 1138-1140).
Agreement with f_!: a closed subset of X_V proper over V is finite over V because f is locally quasi-finite, so the set equals f_!F(V) by its very definition (proof lines 1141-1144).
